article_title: Complaints to watchdog about water firms jump 84%

tasks.prompt: What is the main reason complaints to the water-industry watchdog rose so sharply?
options: Concern and confusion about rising bills
A nationwide ban on water meters
The closure of the consumer watchdog
A fall in the number of households served
tasks.correct_answer: Concern and confusion about rising bills
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה קושרת את העלייה בתלונות בעיקר לחשש ולבלבול של לקוחות בעקבות התייקרות החשבונות.

tasks.prompt: How many complaints did the Consumer Council for Water receive in 2025-26?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מספר התלונות ל־CCW עלה מ־8,235 בשנה הקודמת ל־15,115 בשנת 2025–26.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does the phrase “steep price hikes” mean?
options: Bills that are difficult to calculate
Prices that change every month
Large and sudden increases in prices
Discounts offered to low-income customers
tasks.correct_answer: Large and sudden increases in prices
tasks.explanation_hebrew: steep price hikes פירושו עליות מחירים חדות ומשמעותיות, ולא שינוי קטן או הנחה.

tasks.prompt: Which two companies were rated “poor” on both complaint measures?
options: Portsmouth Water and Bristol Water
Severn Trent and Wessex Water
Southern Water and South East Water
Thames Water and South West Water
tasks.correct_answer: Thames Water and South West Water
tasks.explanation_hebrew: CCW דירג את Thames Water ואת South West Water כחלשות בשני המדדים שנבדקו.

tasks.prompt: Why does the CCW say companies should explain more clearly how customers' money is invested?
options: Customers want to see real improvements after paying higher bills
Customers are asking companies to stop all infrastructure work
The watchdog wants every household to receive the same bill
Water companies are no longer allowed to contact customers
tasks.correct_answer: Customers want to see real improvements after paying higher bills
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הלקוחות משלמים יותר ולכן מצפים לראות ולהבין כיצד הכסף יוצר שיפור ממשי בשירות ובתשתיות.

tasks.prompt: What does Water UK mean by saying upgrades are “vital”?
options: They are optional but popular
They are essential and necessary
They are temporary and inexpensive
They are limited to redesigned bills
tasks.explanation_hebrew: vital פירושו חיוני והכרחי; הארגון טוען שההשקעות דרושות לאספקת מים, לצמיחה ולצמצום ביוב בנהרות ובים.

tasks.prompt: Compare the changes in complaints made to the CCW and directly to water companies.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את שני שיעורי העלייה ואת המספרים הכוללים, ולהבחין בין תלונה לחברה לבין פנייה ל־CCW.
expected_points: CCW complaints rose by 84%
They increased from 8,235 to 15,115
Direct complaints to companies rose by 56%
Direct complaints totalled 321,347
Customers must first complain directly to their water company before approaching the CCW

tasks.prompt: Explain why higher bills may lead to more complaints even if companies say the money is needed for upgrades.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את המתח בין הוצאה מיידית של הלקוח לבין שיפור עתידי, וכן בעיות בהירות, יכולת תשלום ואמון.
expected_points: Customers feel the cost increase immediately
Benefits from infrastructure investment may take time to appear
Some households struggle with affordability
Measured billing and billing administration caused confusion
Customers may distrust companies if spending is not explained clearly
Visible improvements could reduce dissatisfaction

tasks.prompt: Summarise the complaint figures, the strongest and weakest performers, and the industry's response.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את העלייה בתלונות, נושאי התלונות, דירוגי החברות והסבר הענף להתייקרות.
expected_points: Watchdog complaints rose by a record 84% to 15,115
Direct complaints rose 56% to 321,347
Main issues were measured billing, affordability and billing administration
Thames Water and South West Water were poor on both measures
Portsmouth Water and Bristol Water were good on both measures
Water UK said higher bills fund essential upgrades
Water UK said 94% of complaints are resolved at the earliest stage

tasks.prompt: Write a short customer notice explaining a water-bill increase clearly and responsibly.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב הודעה ברורה באנגלית שמציגה את השינוי, השימוש בכסף, אפשרויות סיוע ודרך מסודרת להגשת תלונה.
expected_points: State the size and timing of the bill change
Explain which infrastructure or environmental improvements it funds
Use plain language for measured charges
Offer affordability support
Give a clear complaint process
Set expectations for when customers will see improvements
Avoid dismissing customer concerns
